import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Iris Species Analysis: Sepal and Petal Measurements', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Color palette for species
colors = {'setosa': '#FF6B6B', 'versicolor': '#4ECDC4', 'virginica': '#95E1D3'}
species_colors = [colors[species] for species in df['species']]

# 1. Scatter plot: Sepal Length vs Width
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    mask = df['species'] == species
    ax1.scatter(df[mask]['sepal_length'], df[mask]['sepal_width'], 
               label=species.capitalize(), alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
               color=colors[species])
ax1.set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sepal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax1.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 2. Scatter plot: Petal Length vs Width
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
for species in df['species'].unique():
    mask = df['species'] == species
    ax2.scatter(df[mask]['petal_length'], df[mask]['petal_width'], 
               label=species.capitalize(), alpha=0.7, s=80, edgecolors='black', linewidth=0.5,
               color=colors[species])
ax2.set_xlabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Petal Width (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Petal Dimensions by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax2.legend(frameon=True, shadow=True)
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 3. Box plot: Distribution of Petal Length
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
bp_data = [df[df['species'] == species]['petal_length'].values for species in df['species'].unique()]
bp = ax3.boxplot(bp_data, labels=[s.capitalize() for s in df['species'].unique()], 
                 patch_artist=True, notch=True, showmeans=True,
                 meanprops=dict(marker='D', markerfacecolor='red', markersize=6))
for patch, species in zip(bp['boxes'], df['species'].unique()):
    patch.set_facecolor(colors[species])
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax3.set_ylabel('Petal Length (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Species', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Petal Length Distribution by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# 4. Violin plot: Distribution of all measurements
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
df_melted = pd.melt(df, id_vars=['species'], 
                    value_vars=['sepal_length', 'sepal_width', 'petal_length', 'petal_width'],
                    var_name='measurement', value_name='value')
df_melted['measurement'] = df_melted['measurement'].str.replace('_', ' ').str.title()

sns.violinplot(data=df_melted, x='measurement', y='value', hue='species', 
              ax=ax4, palette=colors, split=False, inner='quartile', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Measurement Type', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Measurement (cm)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Distribution of All Measurements by Species', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=10)
ax4.legend(title='Species', title_fontsize=10, frameon=True, shadow=True, 
          labels=[s.capitalize() for s in df['species'].unique()])
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')
plt.setp(ax4.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=15, ha='right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
